description: Use an iPhone or iPad as the camera, microphone, trackpad and keyboard of your computer
notes: This installs the app itself, unprivileged: no UAC prompt, nothing in Program Files.
The virtual camera needs a driver, and the tray/shell integration comes from the MSI in the same archive. If you want those, run install.cmd as administrator from the installed directory.
Local network use is free. Remote access from outside your network is a subscription.
